🌍 Lebanese speaker warns of ‘sedition’ after framework agreement with Israeli regime

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Lebanese Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri issues a statement on Saturday warning nation against falling into “Fitna” following framework agreement signed under US mediation

Berri warned of the consequences of a framework agreement signed between the Lebanese government and the Israeli regime under US mediation, urging Lebanese citizens to avoid being drawn into what he called a Fitna, which roughly means sedition.
​
The statement, reported Saturday the Al-Ahed news website, was issued shortly after the deal’s signing.
​
In the brief statement addressed to the Lebanese people, Berri said: “O people of Lebanon, all of Lebanon; this is sedition.”
​
He quoted Imam Ali (AS) from Nahj al-Balagha, urging the people to be like “Ibn al-Laboun” (a two-year-old camel), “neither having a back to ride nor udders to milk”, from a well-known metaphor in Arab culture for avoiding any stance or action that could be exploited to fuel division.
​
Without elaborating further, Berri warned about the situation ahead and the potential consequences of the agreement.
​
The warning follows five rounds of negotiations and four days of talks in Washington, where Lebanon and the Israeli regime reached a framework for a future agreement on Friday under US mediation.
​

⚙️ How it’s supposed to work

STRC — an instrument Saylor designed with the help of AI — is intended to keep its price hovering around $100.

If the price falls, the company raises the yield to attract more buyers. The price is supposed to recover. Think of it as an automatic stabilizer.

❓ Why this is interesting 

Right now, STRC is trading at roughly $83, despite its $100 target value. The yield has already been increased, but the market isn't responding the way the model was designed to.

This is the first real stress test of the entire structure. If the mechanism fails to stabilize the price, the company will either have to keep increasing payouts to investors or buy less Bitcoin.
